messages:
Marta: quick heads-up 0:30 UTC release preflight: deploy-bot failed final promote for `notifications-service` with checksum mismatch. anyone free to triage?

deploy-bot: Promote blocked: notifications-service@canary-20260425 -> verify failed. expected sha256:9a8b7c6d... observed sha256:0f1e2d3c...

Jin: build #12095 shows upload ok. registry HEAD returned the expected digest initially, then a subsequent verify returned different digest during promote attempt.

ci-bot: Build 12095: status=success. Uploader returned 200. No retry logs on CI side.

Marta: Immediate mitigation: pin canary to last-green digest from last smoke (sha256:9a8b7c6dfeedface), promote, run smoke. In parallel infra should check registry indexer and storage layer.

Jin: I'll run the pin and kick a NO_REMOTE_CACHE rebuild to confirm.

Marta: Executing pin now:
```
deploybot promote --service notifications-service --image notifications-service@sha256:9a8b7c6dfeedface --env canary --reason "pin-after-promote-checksum-mismatch" --notify slack:eng-releases
```

deploy-bot: Pin promotion applied. notifications-service@sha256:9a8b7c6dfeedface -> canary.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild pipeline #12102 with NO_REMOTE_CACHE=1. Status: queued.

Jin: Starting smoke tests against pinned canary (health, send/receive quick flow, latency).
deploy-bot: Smoke pipeline #12103 started.

Marta: Also applying a manual release hold until we confirm rebuild digest matches pinned and infra verifies no registry race.

release-manager: Manual hold applied. Notifying product. Adding 45m hold window.

ci-bot: Smoke #12103 results: health=pass, send/receive=pass, latency=within-baseline.

Jin: Rebuild #12102 completed. Upload digest matches pinned sha256:9a8b7c6dfeedface. Registry HEAD stable.

infra-oncall: Investigating storage logs. Found a short-lived indexer rehash at 10:24 UTC that may have caused a stale index entry to be read during promote. We'll file INF-2055. Mitigation: add pre-promote HEAD double-check plus 3 retry attempts with exponential backoff in deploybot and prevent indexer rehashes during release windows.

Marta: Sounds good. Please add a small deploybot fallback: if promote verify fails twice, auto-pin to last-known-good digest and notify release channel instead of blocking indefinitely.

infra-oncall: Noted. INF-2055 created: "Indexer rehash race causing transient checksum mismatches during promote" assigned to infra. Action items: bump index snapshot locks during release windows, add deploybot verify retries and auto-pin fallback.

release-manager: Hold removed after 32 minutes; proceeding with staged promotes. Added to release notes: "Canary briefly pinned due to artifact verification transient during promote; resolved by pin and rebuild, no customer impact."

Marta: Thanks all. We'll watch metrics for 60m and then proceed with the cut if stable. :thumbsup:
